-- 논리코어가 8 개 이상인 서버의 서버명, 논리코어 수, 메모리 용량을 논리코어 내림차순으로 조회
SELECT
    COALESCE(c.platform_resource_id, c.id) AS id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type = 'server.Server' THEN COALESCE(c.name, c.hostname) END) AS server_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type = 'server.Server' THEN c.hostname END) AS hostname,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type = 'server.Server' THEN c.ipaddress END) AS ipaddress,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type = 'server.Server' AND cc.name = 'OSType' THEN cc.stringvalue_short END) AS ostype,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type = 'server.Server' AND cc.name = 'OSVerson' THEN cc.stringvalue_short END) AS osversion,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type = 'server.Cpus' AND cc.name = 'LOGICALCORE' THEN CASE WHEN UPPER(cc.stringvalue_short) LIKE '%TB%' THEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), 1, LENGTH(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short)) - 2)), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) * 1024 WHEN UPPER(cc.stringvalue_short) LIKE '%GB%' THEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), 1, LENGTH(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short)) - 2)), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) WHEN UPPER(cc.stringvalue_short) LIKE '%MB%' THEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), 1, LENGTH(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short)) - 2)), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) / 1024.0 WHEN UPPER(cc.stringvalue_short) LIKE '%KB%' THEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), 1, LENGTH(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short)) - 2)), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) / 1048576.0 ELSE CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) END END) AS logicalcore,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type = 'server.Memory' AND cc.name = 'TotalSize' THEN cc.stringvalue_short END) AS mem_size
FROM polestar.cmm_resource c
LEFT JOIN polestar.core_config_prop cc
    ON c.resource_conf_id = cc.configuration_id
WHERE c.resource_type IN ('server.Server', 'server.Cpus', 'server.Memory')
  AND c.dtime IS NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(c.platform_resource_id, c.id)
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type = 'server.Cpus' AND cc.name = 'LOGICALCORE' THEN CASE WHEN UPPER(cc.stringvalue_short) LIKE '%TB%' THEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), 1, LENGTH(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short)) - 2)), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) * 1024 WHEN UPPER(cc.stringvalue_short) LIKE '%GB%' THEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), 1, LENGTH(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short)) - 2)), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) WHEN UPPER(cc.stringvalue_short) LIKE '%MB%' THEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), 1, LENGTH(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short)) - 2)), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) / 1024.0 WHEN UPPER(cc.stringvalue_short) LIKE '%KB%' THEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), 1, LENGTH(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short)) - 2)), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) / 1048576.0 ELSE CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) END END) >= 8
ORDER BY logicalcore DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1000;

-- 논리코어가 8 개 이상인 서버의 서버명, 논리코어 수, 메모리 용량을 논리코어 내림차순으로 조회
SELECT
    COALESCE(c.platform_resource_id, c.id) AS id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type = 'server.Server' THEN COALESCE(c.name, c.hostname) END) AS server_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type = 'server.Server' THEN c.hostname END) AS hostname,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type = 'server.Server' THEN c.ipaddress END) AS ipaddress,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type = 'server.Server' AND cc.name = 'OSType' THEN cc.stringvalue_short END) AS ostype,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type = 'server.Server' AND cc.name = 'OSVerson' THEN cc.stringvalue_short END) AS osversion,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type = 'server.Cpus' AND cc.name = 'LOGICALCORE' THEN CASE WHEN UPPER(cc.stringvalue_short) LIKE '%TB%' THEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), 1, LENGTH(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short)) - 2)), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) * 1024 WHEN UPPER(cc.stringvalue_short) LIKE '%GB%' THEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), 1, LENGTH(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short)) - 2)), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) WHEN UPPER(cc.stringvalue_short) LIKE '%MB%' THEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), 1, LENGTH(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short)) - 2)), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) / 1024.0 WHEN UPPER(cc.stringvalue_short) LIKE '%KB%' THEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), 1, LENGTH(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short)) - 2)), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) / 1048576.0 ELSE CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) END END) AS logicalcore,
    MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type = 'server.Memory' AND cc.name = 'TotalSize' THEN cc.stringvalue_short END) AS mem_size
FROM polestar.cmm_resource c
LEFT JOIN polestar.core_config_prop cc
    ON c.resource_conf_id = cc.configuration_id
WHERE c.resource_type IN ('server.Server', 'server.Cpus', 'server.Memory')
  AND c.dtime IS NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(c.platform_resource_id, c.id)
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN c.resource_type = 'server.Cpus' AND cc.name = 'LOGICALCORE' THEN CASE WHEN UPPER(cc.stringvalue_short) LIKE '%TB%' THEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), 1, LENGTH(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short)) - 2)), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) * 1024 WHEN UPPER(cc.stringvalue_short) LIKE '%GB%' THEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), 1, LENGTH(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short)) - 2)), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) WHEN UPPER(cc.stringvalue_short) LIKE '%MB%' THEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), 1, LENGTH(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short)) - 2)), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) / 1024.0 WHEN UPPER(cc.stringvalue_short) LIKE '%KB%' THEN CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), 1, LENGTH(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short)) - 2)), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) / 1048576.0 ELSE CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(cc.stringvalue_short), '') AS DECIMAL(31, 6)) END END) >= 8
ORDER BY logicalcore DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1000;
